_about: One place for the operator's public details (DECISIONS.md D141). Read by site/build.mjs (every page's footer, the Contact section, the Meta tag), the app (mobile/src/constants/site-config.ts), the Edge Functions (supabase/functions/_shared/site-config.ts) and the engine's user agent (engine/src/remitbridge_engine/config.py). Change a value here and each picks it up on its next build, deploy or run. CONTACT_EMAIL is hello@remitbridgelabs.org, forwarded to the RemitBridge Gmail by ImprovMX and sent from Gmail through Resend (2026-10-03). INCORPORATED turns true only when Washington's Secretary of State has accepted the Articles. Empty strings render nothing. Never a home address.
